items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: I got with those Johnson boys... So we would close the show on the off him... I used to hang around New York and go to these house rank parties... and play and just got acquainted with them that way.

ctx.x: When you first came to California, do you remember about what year was there or did you go on the road first? You said to New York someplace before you came here?

No, out of school, yes. I worked for the United Fruit Company boat. Oh, yeah. Yeah. And that's how I got to New York. So, I got with those Johnson boys, as I said. Let's see, one was a guitar player and the other was a bass player. Did you know them? The Johnsons?

Well, there's so many Johnsons. Is that Bill Johnson, you think? No, no, no, no. Wasn't that bunch? No, Bill Johnson from Monk. From out here. The bass player, yeah. He was out here already. That's why I remember him.

items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Johnson. He was at Dunbar's Tennessee Tanks, too. Well, yeah, that's when I got out here, but I didn't go back, see?
